registration.decision_state: already registered in the canonical register; this workspace adds no identifier
registration.workspace_created: 2026-09-28 on the owner's instruction, replacing a card-only presence

question.asked: Do exposure duration and fibroblast IL-1 reception separately determine mature epithelial recovery after verified withdrawal?
what_is_not_being_asked: whether a transitional RNA score declines after withdrawal
whether receptor or inhibitor RNA predicts an inflammatory RNA response (that is A12)
whether a fibroblast programme adds information in human cross-sections (that is A13)

H1_duration.statement: longer IL-1beta exposure reduces mature epithelial recovery after verified withdrawal, relative to transient exposure at matched intensity
H1_duration.population: alveolar epithelial cells in a system where exposure can be started and stopped and the same preparation followed afterwards
H1_duration.primary_outcome: mature-cell yield per unit after a fixed post-withdrawal interval
safeguards: traced descendants where a lineage label exists
rivals: time in culture or in vivo rather than time under exposure
H1_duration.decision: a recovery difference after verified withdrawal supports H1; a precise absence weakens it; failed engagement or no post-withdrawal observation is inconclusive

H2_reception.statement: fibroblast IL-1 reception modifies epithelial recovery beyond direct epithelial reception of the same signal
H2_reception.population: a system containing both compartments in which IL1R1 can be removed from one compartment at a time under fixed exposure
H2_reception.primary_outcome: mature-cell yield per unit, defined identically to H1
H2_reception.decision: an outcome change under fibroblast-specific intervention with epithelial reception controlled supports H2; a precise absence weakens it; failed engagement is inconclusive

must_not_be_combined_into_one_experiment: arms varying exposure duration and receiving compartment together confound the two claims, and the two hypotheses have different control requirements

unit_and_inference.unit: the animal, or an independently prepared culture
unit_and_inference.floor: at least three independent units per arm with identities recorded
unit_and_inference.repeat_wells_are_not_preparations: four wells split from a common mixture count as one unit (A2 recovered methods)

motivating_but_non_answering_evidence.A12: exploratory 12-patient pilot: recipient receptor and inhibitor RNA improved held-out prediction of an inflammatory RNA response; fibroblast increment unstable; no withdrawal, no reception measurement
motivating_but_non_answering_evidence.A13: amended pilot: no aggregate held-out gain from a fibroblast programme; RMSE 0.2283 to 0.2373; human cross-section

feasibility_state_on_2026_09_28.note: the survey covered the A1 documents rather than the public archives or the group's own capability; this is not a claim that the experiment is infeasible

prohibitions: reading loss of a transitional RNA score as recovery
combining the two hypotheses into one experiment
claiming withdrawal without measured post-withdrawal engagement
treating receptor or inhibitor RNA as measured reception
counting repeat wells from one mixture as independent preparations
presenting an anticipated response curve as a result
extending either result to malignant transformation
